##### Project general facts

Gulf Tower by GJ Properties is a striking 30-storey residential development located in the heart of Ajman, offering a refined selection of 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartments. The architecture is defined by a contemporary high-rise design that combines elegance with functionality, creating a strong visual presence within the city skyline. Each residence is carefully planned with spacious layouts and large balconies, designed to maximise natural light, openness, and panoramic views that enhance everyday living.

The development offers a well-balanced lifestyle supported by a range of practical and lifestyle-focused amenities. Retail spaces located on the ground floor ensure everyday necessities are just steps away from home, adding convenience to daily life. Residents benefit from a thoughtfully designed environment that combines urban accessibility with a sense of comfort and calm, making it suitable for both peaceful living and active city lifestyles within a thriving community setting.

Inside, Gulf Tower features modern finishing with high-quality materials that enhance the overall sense of comfort and sophistication. The apartments are designed with functional layouts and refined detailing, creating bright and welcoming interiors. Kitchens come equipped with premium European appliances, including a cooker, hood, and dishwasher/dryer, ensuring a fully functional and modern cooking experience. The residences are delivered unfurnished, allowing residents to personalise their homes according to their own taste and lifestyle preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

Ajman the smallest yet most diverse of all emirates in UAE. Located strategically in the middle of the emirates, it borders Sharjah and only 10 km away from Dubai. Hence, it provides an easy commute to other emirates. The perennial sunshine of its golden shores sitting alongside the serene beaches is a heaven away from the hassles of life. Its untouched landscapes, misty mangroves, Age-old traditions and authentic culture, along with the contemporary infrastructure make it a unique place to experience.

Ajman’s diversity and sustainable development attracts a large number of investors who are keen to tap into its lucrative business opportunities. The opening of Ajman’s free zone and visa extensions for investors is injecting more liquidity into the local economy and is boosting the underlying confidence of foreign investors. New laws by the UAE government to grant citizenship to expatriates and easing the rules to provide a conducive atmosphere for them, Ajman is rapidly growing as a major hub for prospective investors to live and work in.

The overall vibe of this emirate, due to the rate of new developments and years’ old traditions, is so soothing that it has an edge over other emirates to cater to anyone seeking comfort, luxury, and tranquility at the same time.
